{{Quote|It doesn't get any better than this&mdash;a massive, mouthwatering Alderaanian nerfsteak, cooked to order and smothered with melted jerba cheese, grilled Ojomian onions and Felucian glasscap mushrooms.|Dex's Diner menu, on its fried nerfsteak|<ref name="Menu" />}}
A '''Felucian glasscap mushroom''' was a type of [[Mushroom/Legends|mushroom]]<ref name="Menu" /> that shared its name with [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] and its [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Jungle Felucian/Legends|Jungle Felucians]]<ref name="Force Unleashed">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed novelization ]]''</ref> The [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] served the [[Foodstuff/Legends|mushrooms]] with the fried [[Nerf steak/Legends|nerf steak]]s and the [[gartro egg omelet]]s that he sold at his [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]], [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]],<ref name="Menu" /> on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Menu" />

==Behind the scenes==
Felucian glasscap mushrooms were mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
